description: Land Acquisition - Asgiriya Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifying particular land parcels with detailed descriptions of their boundaries and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) issuing the order, the core content focuses exclusively on land matters - the acquisition of specific properties with detailed land descriptions, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
